learned: 2026-10-08, agent pass. flavinc.com is a WordPress/Elementor marketing site for MO, AZ and NY, with no shop: no WooCommerce, no Shopify, and its 'product' post type holds 9 line pages with no SKUs or sizes. Each line page does state its fixed formats and sizes in prose and lists its flavours or strain pairs in 'spotlight' blocks (<span class=flavor-span>). Some blocks are labelled by state. This recipe reads the blocks that are New York's, or that NY stores sell from, one page fetch per block and size: Rings, Live Resin Sour Belts, Distillate AIO vapes, and the Flav Duos family (whole flower, ready-to-roll and infused ready-to-roll 14g, infused pre-roll 8-pack 4g). That is 53 entries. The 'Test Distru' page (flavinc.com/test-distru/) embeds a public Distru wholesale menu (company 492724, menu 3570). It belongs to White Mountain Health Center (FLAV), the Arizona licensee, and carries 300mg rings and AZ-only vapes, so it is not used as a source. Its product copy is the brand's own and fixes which flavours come in megadose.
notes: Sizes come from each line page's prose, set by rules keyed on the '#<format>-<size>' fragment of each url. Rings: 'standard dose (100mg/10mg per piece) or megadose (100mg/50mg per piece or 300mg 30mg per piece)'. In NY that is 10pk 100mg and 2pk 100mg; 300mg is over New York's 100mg cap, and only the Arizona Distru menu sells it. Belts: '10mg to 100mg per piece', so in NY a 10pk 100mg and a 1pk 100mg megadose belt. Distillate vapes: 'a full-gram tank' AIO, 1g. Duos: 'Whole Flower comes 14 grams, split 7 and 7', ready-to-roll 14g, 'Pre-Roll 8-pack at 4 grams total'.

Megadose flavours are not on flavinc.com. The skip rules keep the ones the brand's own Distru product copy names: rings 'Peach, Cherry, and Watermelon', belts 'Megadose Rainbow, Blueberry, and Strawberry'. NY stores sell exactly those six. If the brand adds a megadose flavour, edit the skip rules.

Blocks are picked by their spotlight post id (.e-loop-item-<id>), which stays the same when the brand edits a list: 3290 rings flavours, 3593 belt flavours, 3619 distillate strains, 3626 whole flower duos, 3628 infused ready-to-roll duos, 3629 regular ready-to-roll duos, 9003241321010132 infused pre-roll 8-pack duos. A NEW block (a new format or state list) needs a new `also` entry. The same ids are in https://flavinc.com/wp-json/wp/v2/spotlight?per_page=100.

Left out as not New York's, or with no NY evidence: Missouri strain pre-rolls (2 and 5 packs) and Hash Rosin rings (both labelled MO), Infused Flower 3.5g (its strains are the MO pre-roll list), Cones (on the MO ordering page), Snap Duo 2G vapes (on the AZ ordering page), Live Resin 1G vapes and Sleep & Relief gummies (no state named and no NY store listing; Sleep & Relief's three flavours are not tied to its CBG and CBN products).

The NY ordering page says Flower Duos are 'exclusively available' in New York. The infused pre-roll page labels the six 8-pack pairs 'New York Strains', with the same pairs as the 8-pack block on /products/flower/flower-duos/ that is read here. That block spells them as stores do ('Hippie Crasher', where the NY block has 'Hippy'). Two title rules fix its 'Sour tangie' and 'Mr Nice Guy'.

Lines: 'Rings', 'Belts' (the site's 'Live Resin Sour Belts'; Live Resin is the extract) and 'Duos' (Flav Duos, a family printed across flower and pre-roll formats). Megadose is a size of the same product (2pk or 1pk 100mg), not a line. Distillate vapes have no line. Infused ready-to-roll duos are subtype infused and regular ones preground.

Whole flower duo names keep the site's '&' ('Black Cherry Gelato & Grape Soda'). The other duo blocks use 'x'. A store that writes a whole flower pair in the other order will not match until it is aliased. 'Granddaddy Purp' is the site's spelling.

Store names: stores put the line after the flavour ('Peach Rings', 'Blueberry Belts', 'Rainbow Mega Belt') or use 'Live Resin Belts'. store_aliases map those to the site's line and flavour. 'Apple' rings and belts are the site's 'Green Apple' (the brand's Distru menu says 'Apple Rings' and 'Green Apple Belts').

Only at stores, and correctly so: Rainbow Poppers (20pk x 5mg, not on the site), and single-strain 1g live resin infused pre-rolls of the NY duo strains (Pineapple Dream, Sour Tangie). The site mentions a '2-pack (1g) single strain' but lists strains for it only under Missouri.

megadose belts come in Rainbow, Blueberry and Strawberry only (the brand's own copy: 'Megadose Rainbow, Blueberry, and Strawberry flavors')
